title: Oversea's Wound
summary: The wereshark account of the moon and their auspices.

claims.text: Rokea say the moon is a wound in Oversea, the sky, healed by a glowing salve; the stars are smaller wounds seen when the great one is soothed.

A wereshark born when the salve runs low, at the full moon, is a Brightwater warrior; one born when it is plentiful is a Darkwater scholar or innovator; those born between are Dimwater, who go their own way and often travel.

Their tale says Qyrl made the first lesser spawn from Oversea's blood, and Kun and C'et learned that new life needed Sea, Unsea and Oversea together; Kun then made the fishes, and on land the Great Kings, which built things before they died.
After its first long swim a young Rokea is guided by an elder to a Grotto and enters Sea's Soul, a spirit world reached as if diving into a perfect reflection.
There Sea speaks to each shark alone, naming its auspice, offering advice and teaching Gifts; reaching Sea's Soul from land is almost impossible.
Darkwaters are credited with the Rite of the Black Shark and the first foretelling of a Small Wound, and some claim Mizuchi was one; most Rokea see Mizuchi and the Asian weresharks as traitors.
Rokea who spend time on land, swimming between, risk being hunted by their own kind.
